g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Reducing Shadows and Skew When Scanning Documents with a
Smartphone
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-24
Before shooting: Choose a spot that
prevents shadows
Shadows usually occur when a person's body or
smartphone blocks the light.
While shooting: Shoot parallel to the
guide lines
Google Drive Help says that when you point at a
document, blue lines indicate the area to crop.
Before saving: Check the corners and
filter yourself
First, check whether the corners detected by the
app match the actual edges of the paper.
Four checks before saving
① Do all four corners align inside the paper? ②
Are the lines of text close to horizontal on the
screen? ③ In the shadowed areas, are any letter…
